message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red border on the left. At the top, the red title "TEMPO" is set above the text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Further text includes "SEKJEN PDIP: KAMI BUKAN PARTAI KOMUNIS", "SIAPA TERIMA SUAP BAKAMLA", "RIBUT-RIBUT LAHAN GAMBUT", and a four-line paragraph about peatland regulations.

The main image features two people from the chest up against a background of wavy, textured grey land. On the left, a person with dark hair wears a white collared shirt and a dark jacket. On the right, a person with dark hair and glasses wears a light-colored long-sleeved shirt and denim overalls. This person holds a dark pitchfork with four glowing orange tines in their right hand. Both individuals have purple-tinted skin and are looking toward the right. In the bottom right corner, text reads "Airlangga Hartarto dan Siti Nurbaya." The bottom left corner contains a barcode and publication details: "22-28 MEI 2017", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273".
